About the Major Taylor (Westchester Parkway laps) group ride

Major Taylor (Westchester Parkway laps) is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Westchester Parkway.

Tuesday-evening laps on Westchester Parkway by LAX, 4.5 miles and 60 feet a lap, during Daylight Saving Time. Race training, not a social ride; Big Orange’s page says half of every lap is into the headwind. The page names the parkway, not a corner; ask on the club’s Strava where the group gathers.
